name: Full-blown ERP implementation for a regulated trade

mentions.name: Full-blown ERP implementation for a regulated trade
mentions.description: A full-blown ERP being implemented for a complicated regulated trade, replacing a 15-year-old SaaS that has not had a major overhaul in a while; the author sees big room for improvement and simplification in the process.
mentions.problem: The incumbent SaaS has been in business 15 years and hasn't had a major overhaul in a while.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was also laid off at the start of this year (again) and currently implementing a full blown ERP for a complicated regulated trade.
mentions.author: d675
